related.title: Event Sourcing：事件重播、快照與重複事件
related.titleEn: Event Sourcing: event replay,snapshots and duplicate events
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 claims-boundaries.csv及aud/nonce/expiry負面案例。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver claims-boundaries.csv and audience,nonce and expiry negative cases.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 從零重播與從e2後快照120接續e3兩路結果均140；每個事件最多套用一次。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Full replay and replay from the post-e2 snapshot120 followed by e3 both yield140;apply each event at most once. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 4600-1000 = 3600 s；對照 4600+30 = 4630 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
授權時效3600 s，教學策略接受now<4630；4631拒絕。有效時間但aud不含本client或nonce不符也一律拒絕。

基準 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units；對照 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
從零重播與從e2後快照120接續e3兩路結果均140；每個事件最多套用一次。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 4600-1000 = 3600 s; comparison 4600+30 = 4630 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Lifetime is3600 s,and the teaching policy accepts now<4630;4631 fails. An audience or nonce mismatch must fail even within the time window.

Baseline 100+50-30 = 120 credit-units; comparison 100+50-30+20 = 140 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Full replay and replay from the post-e2 snapshot120 followed by e3 both yield140;apply each event at most once.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: seL4：能力權限與最小授權
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 claims-boundaries.csv及aud/nonce/expiry負面案例。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver claims-boundaries.csv and audience,nonce and expiry negative cases.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 畫能力衍生樹與endpoint；建立principal、object、right矩陣，為每項訊息行為列最小需求。
related.differenceEn: Draw the capability derivation tree and endpoint; tabulate principal, object and right with each message’s minimum requirements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 4600-1000 = 3600 s；對照 4600+30 = 4630 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
授權時效3600 s，教學策略接受now<4630；4631拒絕。有效時間但aud不含本client或nonce不符也一律拒絕。

能力同時識別物件與可行權限；衍生能力不能超出原能力授權。撤銷與刪除的物件關係須明確。
本課數值核對：3-1 = 2 removed_rights；另一項核對：1/3 = 0.333333333333 remaining_ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 4600-1000 = 3600 s; comparison 4600+30 = 4630 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Lifetime is3600 s,and the teaching policy accepts now<4630;4631 fails. An audience or nonce mismatch must fail even within the time window.

A capability identifies an object and allowed rights; a derived capability must not exceed its authority. Distinguish the object relationships of revoke and delete.
Numeric audit: 3-1 = 2 removed_rights; second audit: 1/3 = 0.333333333333 remaining_ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
